Analysis

The subject's own leasing history is stale — its most recent close was $3,600 back in September 2022, and the North Arlington rental market has moved since then. All six comparables above closed within the past eight months and give a current read on the submarket.

The three closest matches to the subject on size, age, and style are 3165 21st St N (1,497 SF, $3,975), 1526 N Utah St (1,180 SF Cape Cod, $4,250), and 4313 N 18th St N (1,600 SF Cape Cod, $3,600) — the tightest peer group for a ~1,527 SF, 3-bed, 1930s-era Cape Cod. Their blended rate is $2.84/SF, which scales to about $4,330/mo for the subject's above-grade footprint.

The spread inside that peer group is wide — 1526 N Utah St leased at $3.60/SF (excellent condition, updated kitchen/baths, detached garage) while 4313 N 18th St N leased at $2.25/SF (dated finishes). Where 2219 Military Rd lands in that range depends on its current condition and how it shows once the tenant's belongings are out — worth a walkthrough before finalizing the number.

  • Fully finished basement is a plus most peer comps don't call out explicitly — worth highlighting in the listing remarks.
  • 1526 N Utah St took 52 days to lease despite hitting full ask — the market isn't moving instantly at the top of the range.
  • 1609 N Kirkwood Rd closed over its last list price with 0 DOM — strong comps still move fast when priced and presented right.
Recommended Pricing
List at $4,100/mo
Expected range to lease: $3,900 – $4,150/mo, condition-dependent. Revisit after a walkthrough — fresh paint and any deferred maintenance addressed could support the top of the range, in line with 1526 N Utah St's outcome.
